ja284:1.1: Whoever zealously gathers a lot of wealth, without fortune,
ja284:1.3: Those with skill, those without skill, having good luck, can enjoy that (wealth).
ja284:2.1: Everywhere to the one who made merit, overcoming beings,
ja284:2.3: A lot of wealth will arise,
ja284:3.1: A chicken, jewels, a staff, and women are (all) signs of merit,
ja284:3.3: They arise for the person, without wickedness, who made merit.
